items.title: Spider with a Leaf Umbrella
items.alt: A playful spider holds a broad leaf overhead with one front leg while its other seven legs balance beside a tiny raindrop.
items.description: A playful spider holds a broad leaf overhead with one front leg while its other seven legs balance beside a tiny raindrop. Useful for weather story cards.

items.title: Spider Mending a Web
items.alt: A smiling brown spider reaches two front legs toward dark silk threads in a wooden hoop, with six other jointed legs visible below its two-part body.
items.description: A smiling brown spider reaches two front legs toward dark silk threads in a wooden hoop, with six other jointed legs visible below its two-part body. Useful for stories about making and repairing.

items.title: Spider beside a Thread Spool
items.alt: A brown spider stands beside a wooden thread spool with eight distinct legs and a loose strand looping beside its body.
items.description: A brown spider stands beside a wooden thread spool with eight distinct legs and a loose strand looping beside its body. Useful for making and building prompts.
